Account page now produces zero horizontal page overflow at 390x844, 414x896, and 360x780 across all 6 tabs (18/18 combinations). Swipe-to-confirm partial-drag still rejects. Photos step is camera-only with zero file inputs. Admin login still loads.
critical_code_review_comments: Account.jsx fix is solid: outer wrapper has overflow-x-hidden, aside has lg:col-span-3 min-w-0, section has lg:col-span-9 min-w-0 overflow-x-hidden. The mobile pill bar with -mx-4 negative margin still has scrollWidth 674 > offsetWidth 390 (which is intentional — it remains the horizontal-scroll affordance for the 6 tabs), but because the outer page wrapper is overflow-x-hidden the document scrollWidth equals clientWidth at every viewport tested.

Visual confirmation: at 390px on the Activity tab (worst offender previously), the KPI cards (Total Pickups / Completed / Diverted / Saved via coupons) now render inside the viewport. Headings text-xl sm:text-2xl render correctly.
Pill bar still scrolls inside the aside (asideScrollWidth=374, pillRowScroll=674) — labels are not clipped, tab switching via *-btn-mobile testids works for all 6 tabs.

SwipeToConfirm verified again on EXP-9036: exec-action-accept present with label 'Slide to accept pickup'; a 40% partial drag does NOT confirm (slider stays on accept, exec-action-on-the-way is absent).

ExecutiveCompletePickup.jsx code-verified: only data-testid='exec-photos-camera-btn' (line 416) exists; no input[type=file] anywhere in the file; exec-photos-upload testid removed. Live page also showed 0 file inputs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three PR items VERIFIED PASS: (1) Swipe-to-confirm on /executive/pickups/EXP-9036 (partial drag rejects, full drag confirms — partial-drag rejection re-verified this iteration). (2) Camera-only photos on /executive/pickups/EXP-9036/complete (zero file inputs, only exec-photos-camera-btn). (3) /dashboard/me horizontal overflow fix: scrollWidth === clientWidth at 360x780, 390x844, and 414x896 on every tab (profile, addresses, notifications, security, billing, activity). Verification JS used: document.documentElement.scrollWidth === document.documentElement.clientWidth. Pill bar correctly scrolls inside the aside (pillRowScroll=674 > offsetWidth=390) without leaking to the document.
rca of the issue: Iteration 9 RCA was correct. Mitigation applied in this PR: Account.jsx root wrapper got 'overflow-x-hidden', the lg:col-span-3 aside got 'min-w-0', and the lg:col-span-9 section got 'min-w-0 overflow-x-hidden'. Together these constrain the grid columns from being forced wider than the viewport by child min-content (Activity KPI grid, Billing plan card, Security password inputs) and clip any residual overflow from the pill bar's -mx-4 negative margin so the document never gains a horizontal scrollbar.
